core_insight: AI代理服务在AWS、Google、Azure等主流云平台同步突破，推动AI原生堆栈落地的同时，监管审查与供应链安全风险同步升温。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出ECS Gateway简化容器入口，AWS Emulator提升本地开发体验；Azure推出Foundry Agent Service并集成Copilot，提供AI代理即服务；Google Cloud实验性ClusterNetworkPolicy为GKE提供细粒度网络控制，推动Kubernetes上AI原生工作负载。 AWS在Bedrock上发布GPT-6.1模型并推出Continuum代码漏洞自动检测，深化AI/ML与云服务融合；Google为AlloyDB新增ai.classify、ai.extract函数并在BigQuery Measures中引入知识图谱；Azure通过Cobalt 200专用芯片加速EDA工作负载，展示高性能计算硬件创新。 AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services Introducing new AI functions for AlloyDB: ai.classify and ai.extract Experimenting with ClusterNetworkPolicy in GKE The open AI-native stack on Kubernetes: From open models to distributed inference and agents Building the next generation of multimodal AI experiences with fal in Microsoft Foundry Introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness in Foundry Agent Service Agents aren’t humans (but they kinda are)
